title: GPU Direct Memory Access
help: Allow shaders to read dynamically indexed game memory. Required by games such as Monster Hunter Rise. Restart required.

title: Status Layer
help: Arrange the PSVR status panel in the upper left. Cinema keeps the PSV status display. None hides status in both modes.

title: XR Output Resolution
help: Recommended uses OpenXR suggested dimensions. High is the midpoint to the effective runtime/GPU limit; Ultra uses that limit. Changes output resolution, not game source resolution. Restart required.

title: XR Upscaler
help: Reconstruct each eye or cinema image at headset resolution. Both upscalers support eye-tracked foveation. Does not change guest render scale.

title: Screen Upscaler
help: 2D screen only: reconstruct the guest image at the window resolution when Render Scale is below the screen size. Runs once per presented frame on the GPU after the game; does not change guest render scale.

title: XR Foveated Rendering
help: Reduce shading outside the gaze region in presentation and upscaling. Missing or stale gaze falls back to the fixed centre; unsupported drivers use full rate. Does not reduce guest game rendering. Restart required.

title: XR Foveation Strength
help: Low preserves a larger full-resolution region for text. Applies to both FSR and SGSR.

title: XR Upscale Sharpness
help: FSR uses RCAS sharpening; SGSR adjusts its integrated edge sharpness. Does not change render scale.

title: Swap XR Move Controllers
help: Swap the two Move controller slots for PSVR games that assign hands in the opposite order. Moves pose, buttons, triggers and vibration together. Does not swap headset eyes, XR menu pointers or Bluetooth gamepads. Restart the game to apply.

title: Display Mode
help: Choose XR Cinema to play ordinary games on a large screen in the headset. PSVR games always use immersive XR, including when 2D Screen is selected. Changes apply next launch.

title: Silent Dialogs
help: Automatically acknowledge error notices and single-OK messages, and record them in the log. Choices, text entry and save confirmations remain interactive. Restart the game to apply.

title: Console Language
help: Language reported to games. The game must include the selected language. Takes effect next launch.

title: Force Disable MSAA
help: Experimental: use one sample per pixel to reduce GPU memory and work. May alter edges or effects that use individual samples. Off preserves game MSAA. Restart the game to apply.

title: Shader Cache
help: Keep translated guest shaders and pipeline descriptions on disk and rebuild the game's known pipelines at startup, so later runs skip most shader translation stutter. The cache is replaced automatically after a driver, render scale or MSAA change. Restart the game to apply.

title: Shader Compilation
help: What happens when the game shows something whose shaders have not been built yet (mostly the first time a place or effect is seen; built shaders are kept). Wait: the game pauses until they are ready, so nothing is missing but it stutters. Background: they are built on other threads and the game waits only when it cannot continue without them. Skip until ready: the game keeps going and those objects or effects appear a moment later; the least stutter. Restart the game to apply.

title: Recording Thread
help: Records the game's graphics commands on a separate CPU thread, which raises the frame rate and lets Background / Skip until ready shader compilation hide stutter. Leave it on; turn it off only if a game draws incorrectly. Restart the game to apply.

title: Driver Pipeline Cache
help: Keep the graphics driver's compiled pipelines on disk per game, so pipelines it has built before are not compiled again. Ignored automatically when the driver changes. Restart the game to apply.

title: Texture Quality
help: Asset texture detail: high preserves original quality; medium and low reduce eligible textures while protecting small images. Independent of shading quality. Restart the game to apply.

title: 2D Render Scale
help: Scale render targets in 2D mode. XR and PSVR use XR Render Scale instead. Texture Quality controls asset detail separately. Default: 0.5. Restart the game to apply.

title: XR Render Scale
help: Scale game render targets in XR mode, including PSVR and cinema games. Default: 1.0. Independent of 2D Render Scale. Restart the game to apply.

title: Shading Quality
help: Reduce guest fragment shading on supported GPUs. High is the default. Falls back to full rate when unsupported. Takes effect next launch.
